Broadleaf.description: Broadleaf, a resilient and versatile plant with broad, serrated leaves that rustle softly in the wind, provides a natural boon to those who forage its abundant foliage, enhancing their ability to move silently and undetected while offering a steady supply of leaves for crafting and healing purposes.

Needle.description: The Needle is a slender, resilient component that embodies the essence of nature's survival, its innate toughness allowing its bearer to thrive in the harshest environments. Its subtle magic is attuned to the cycle of seasons, granting the ability to forage for pinecones, symbols of endurance and renewal in the unforgiving wilds.
